note: City of Granite Shoals, TX. INSTRUMENT: Code of Ordinances Ch. 40 (Zoning), replaced in full by Ordinance 885 (adopted 2025-12-09) and amended by Ordinance 894 (2026-08-25); current through Ord. No. 898 (2026-09-22). SOURCE: ecode360.com, pack C (2026-10-07), cross-matched against the register (LDT #800). SCOPE: 3 of Granite Shoals' 8 districts -- R-1, R-2, M-1. The other 5 stay UNROWED: M-2, GB-1, GB-2 and I are SETBACK_CONDITIONAL_NOT_EVALUATED (each has at least one yard that depends on a condition -- which side of the lot, abutting a residential district, or distance from a shoreline -- this pipeline does not evaluate per-parcel); AG is SETBACK_NO_DIMENSIONAL_STANDARDS (§ 40-19 states permitted uses are decided "on a case by case basis" and carries no yard/height/coverage numbers at all). READING RULES: §§ 40-10/40-12/40-14 state front/side/rear as word-numbers ("not less than five feet on each side", "not less than ten feet (street side on corner lot)") rather than digits; those words are coded to their numeric value (5, 5, 10) and the ordinance's own wording is quoted verbatim rather than paraphrased. No lot-coverage or impervious-cover standard is stated anywhere in §§ 40-10/40-12/40-14 for these three districts (confirmed by the live text, not assumed from silence), so max_lot_coverage_pct and max_impervious_pct are not_specified for all three rows. M-1's height subsection states no number at all (confirmed: § 40-14 has no height cell), so max_height_ft is not_specified (999) for M-1 only; R-1 and R-2 both state a height in feet. SENTINELS: not_specified = 100, except max_height_ft's canonical 999. No code-section atom corpus exists yet for granite_shoals_tx; every value is primary-source-verified.
